def make_model(cell, k, m, seed, welfare_mode="geometric_mean"):
    kwargs = dict(
        tax_regime=cell["tax_regime"],
        redistribution_mode=cell["redistribution_mode"],
        k=k, m=m,
        income_threshold=income_threshold,
        wealth_threshold_lower=50,
        wealth_threshold_upper=wealth_threshold_upper,
        autonomous_welfare_mode=welfare_mode,
        seed=seed,
    )
    if cell["tax_regime"] == "uhi_scenario":
        kwargs["uhi_transfer_rate"] = uhi_transfer_rate
    return SugarscapeAITax(**kwargs)

reviewed_calibration_equivalence: Both use seed42 no-policy k=m=0 for200steps;step199medianincome and2xmedianwealth;balancedwealth/means_tested300steps derives2xmeanpositiveTransferReceived. Canonical explicitly sets geometric_mean, matching native default in legacy.
different_observation: Legacy wealth-at-death averages positive per-step means equally. Canonical weights each per-step mean by its death count. These statistics are not interchangeable; cumulative deaths use the same sum.
scope: Source-level protocol comparison, not a replay of the legacy report. Canonical PartB covers the same105simulation settings and cumulative-mortality experiment. No new completed paper or additional independent trials are claimed.
remaining: Do not use legacy unweighted stock-at-death as the current manuscript statistic. Fullpaper still requires remaining robustness and final interpretation.
